subject: english
title: Spelling
description: Lower Key Stage 2 spelling: prefixes and suffixes, common homophones, and words that are often misspelt (English Appendix 1, Years 3 and 4).

objectives.statement: Use further prefixes and understand how to add them (for example, un–, dis–, mis–, in–, re–, sub–, super–, anti–, auto–).
Use further suffixes and understand how to add them (for example, –ation, –ly, –ous).
Spell words that are often confused, including common homophones (for example, there/their/they're, here/hear).
Spell words from the Year 3 and 4 list of commonly misspelt words.
